correctness_method: Single Deletion over raw measurements with empirical training-distribution replacement and deterministic ratio recomputation; Spearman alignment with raw-feature SHAP
continuity_method: Paired Gaussian perturbations on raw features without training-range clipping; derived ratios recomputed; SHAP cosine similarity reported for response-stable rows
noise_scale: fraction of raw-feature training standard deviation
noise_interval: empirical 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles across paired draws
noise_bounds: no clipping; non-positive anthropometric measurements rejected
